SLCT.description: Serviceability Load Combination Type Selection (SLCT). Assigns the serviceability load type to an existing concrete service load combination (nActive==2); LC_NAME must match the existing combination name and SL_TYPE selects the limit-state category.

LC_NAME.description: Serviceability Load Combination Name. Must exactly match the name of an existing concrete service load combination; a mismatch is rejected.

SL_TYPE.description: Serviceability Load Type: 0=Service Limit, 1=Strength Limit1, 2=Strength Limit3. Values outside 0-2 are rejected. Maps internally to nServLcomType (0->0, 1->1, 2->3).
